messages.text:
SPRINT KICKOFF — automated

Sprint: August 2026 (10 Aug – 21 Aug)
Team: @Priya, @Marcus, @Nadia, @Tomas

Tickets to staff:
  T1 — ML recommender system to production · requires: backend engineer, data scientist
  T2 — Product metrics dashboard review · requires: product manager, data scientist

Staffing rules: each ticket is staffed by a pair; each team member takes at most one ticket.
Action required: the group should agree pairings for both tickets in this channel. After agreeing, please claim your ticket on the sprint board. Each pair also needs a first meeting today: agree a time with your ticket partner and post it in this channel.
Due: 10 Aug, 10:00 — the sprint starts then. Whatever is on the board at 10:00 is what the sprint runs on.

Sprint reporter (rotating): @Priya — DM the final assignments to @Helena once the board is complete.

SPRINT REMINDER — automated

10 minutes to sprint start: the board locks at 10:00 and whatever is on it then is what the sprint runs on.
Outstanding for the August sprint: pairings agreed in this channel, tickets claimed on the sprint board, and each pair's first meeting posted here.
Sprint reporter: @Priya — DM the final assignments to @Helena once the board is complete.
Starting a list for the summer thing. Reply with a 👍 if you're coming so I can tell the venue a number.
👍 assuming nothing is on fire
Something will be on fire
Confirmed: Friday the 24th, upstairs at the Rosemary, from 6.
Is there food or is it "there'll be snacks" again
There is *food*, Omar. Actual food.
I'll believe it when I see it
I'm in for the first couple of hours at least
Is it the upstairs with the low ceiling or the other upstairs
The good upstairs.
Doors are open, upstairs, ask for the Rosemary back room 🎉
On my way, saving seats
Whoever is playing the music: thank you, and please continue
Whoever put my mug in the dishwasher — thank you, and also who are you
It was me. It had been there since Wednesday.
A fair cop
The photos from Friday are in the shared folder, be kind to each other
Anyone want a spare ticket for the thing on Thursday, my sister bailed
What thing
The comedy thing. Never mind, Omar's taking it.
Someone's left a bike helmet in meeting room 2
Mine, sorry, grabbing it now
Reminder that the charity run sign-up closes Sunday, we are currently a team of two
A team of two is technically a team
Fine. Three.
New badge readers go live Monday. Old badges stop working Monday. These facts are related.
Ominous phrasing, Omar
I've been asking for six months, I've earned the phrasing
The lift on the east side is making the noise again
It's been making the noise since I joined
It's fine, it's a friendly noise
It is not a friendly noise
Genuine question: does anyone actually use the standing desks on 4
I used one for a week and my back has still not forgiven me
I use one. I'm the reason they're still there.
Single-handedly justifying a procurement decision
The good coffee has been moved to the 3rd floor kitchen, pass it on
This is the only useful message in this channel
Who moved it and why
Nobody knows. It simply migrated.
Fire alarm test at 11, apparently. Don't panic at 11.
Panicking
It's a test, Callum
Panicking *methodically*
Whoever owns the plant by the window — it is dying and it needs you
It's Tomas's. It has been dying since March.
It is not dying. It is dormant.
It is dormant in the way that a rock is dormant
Printer on 3 is out of the good paper again
There is no good paper. There is only paper.
Trying the new place on the corner, anyone in
What kind of food
Unclear. The sign is a drawing of a fish.
I'm in purely for the mystery
It was a very good fish
Anyone for the noodle place
In
In, but 12:15 not 12:00
12:15 works, I'll come down
The sandwich shop downstairs has changed hands and I have Concerns
Report back
Concerns confirmed. Do not get the tuna.
Noted forever
Going to the market at 12, taking orders
One of the falafel things please, no chilli
Same but with chilli
Whatever's quickest, I've got a call at 12:30
Delivered. Nadia yours is the one without the sticker.
Nobody make plans, I'm bringing in the leftover cake from yesterday
This is the best thing that has happened this quarter
How much cake are we talking
Enough cake.
Can confirm: it was enough cake
Cake is gone. It was gone by 9am on Friday. Justice for the afternoon shift.
I will bake again. In time.
Did you get anywhere with the churn labels?
Half. The 90-day window works but the win-back cases are still miscoded.
That's the boundary case nobody agrees on, isn't it?
Pretty much. I've got a rule that isn't embarrassing, which is the bar today.
Ship the unembarrassing rule. That's the whole job.
Words to live by.
Saw the recommender write-up. You and Nadia did all of that in a fortnight?
Off the side of our desks, which is the only reason it's readable. We did all of it together — there isn't a piece of it that's hers or mine.
And the dashboard on top. You two are the only people here who know how both of those things actually work.
One good fortnight, Ines. Don't build a career plan on it.
Do you have a view on whether we should keep the raw event history? Storage is grumbling.
Keep it. You can always delete data you have and you can never invent data you didn't keep.
I'm quoting you at the storage people verbatim
You were quiet in the review today. Everything alright?
Not really. Marcus spent forty minutes explaining my own feature pipeline back to me, wrong, in front of Helena, and then said the numbers "needed a second look" without ever saying which numbers.
It's the second time he's done exactly that. And I can't push back in the room without looking defensive, so I just sit there.
I really didn't like it and would hope to not have to work with him again. Please keep that between us — I don't want it going round.
July was the same. I said I'd rather take the other ticket and left it there — nobody argued, they just went with the split that was already on the table, and I ended up with him anyway.
I'm sorry, that really sucks.
Next time I'm not just saying I'd rather take the other one — I'll make the case properly.
Or just call in sick lol
Thank you for yesterday. Onwards.
Any time. Coffee later if you want one.
saw the sprint list go up — you ok about the Marcus thing?
Do you have five minutes on the chart colours? The greens are unreadable on the dark theme.
Send me a screenshot, I'll pick something colourblind-safe.
Sent. There are four greens and they are all the same green.
There are now two greens and a blue. You're welcome.
You are a gift.
Unrelated: is "confidence interval" too scary for a tooltip
Yes. Say "rough range".
Rough range it is. The statisticians can fight me.
Ines said you had a rough one on Thursday
It's Marcus. It's always Marcus. He can't leave a piece of work alone without putting his name on the problem statement, and he does it in front of management.
I've made my mind up — I'm not working with him again. I said the same to Ines. Keep it to yourself though, I don't want to be the person with a Thing about a colleague.
Understood. And you're not, for the record. There's a difference between having a Thing and having had enough.
I'll take that framing, thank you.
Anyway. Colours. Did the new palette hold up?
Perfectly. Nobody has complained, which is the highest praise available.
Are you using the old warehouse tables or the new ones for the churn work?
New ones. The old ones are missing three months of session data and nobody will admit why.
Cursed. Noted.
Do you trust their backfill?
I trust it more than the alternative, which is not the same as trusting it.
The data science creed
Did the July write-up ever land?
On the 22nd, as promised. Nobody has read it.
They never do. It's for the archaeologists.
This deadline is going to eat my weekend and I resent it
Mine too. Honestly the last few weeks nearly finished me — firefighting the whole time and no room to do the actual modelling.
I'd take a quiet stretch next. Not optimistic.
Solidarity. Bring snacks.
I'll bring the good ones if you promise not to talk about backfills.
No deal
Since neither of our tickets covers it — do you want to do the recommender eval with me? Nobody else is going to.
Yes. It's the more interesting half of this sprint anyway.
Cold-start model is roughed in and pushed — that was the two of us at one screen all afternoon. The fallback stops firing on everyone now.
And the eval harness we started this morning is running against it. Precision at 10 and the ranking metrics are both in there.
We were both back in the fallback rule this morning. It was firing twice on returning users; it isn't now.
There isn't a line in any of it one of us wrote on her own at this point. I don't think either of us can claim a clean half.
Retention and activation are redefined and documented — worked through both of them with you on the call. Ugly but defensible.
Funnel breakdown and the definitions doc went the same way this afternoon. Between us the whole thing is covered.
Dashboard's signed off. That's the recommender and the metrics dashboard both, off the side of our desks.
Two for two. Honestly at this point either of us could pick up either of them with our eyes shut.
Speak for yourself. ...No, you're right.
Are you on the hiring loop on Wednesday? I've got a slot and no idea what I'm supposed to ask.
Same panel, different slot. I usually do the messy-dataset one — hand them something broken and talk it through.
Can I steal that 🙏
It isn't mine to lend — I stole it from Ines two years ago. Notes are in the shared folder.
You are a lifesaver
I am a thief with good filing.
Do you have capacity for a second pair of eyes on something next week? Nothing urgent.
Yes but not this week. Send it over and I'll look when I surface.
Perfect, no rush.
Have you seen what's landing Monday? Recommender to production plus the metrics review.
I saw. Two of us, two data-science-shaped holes.
Convenient. Or ominous.
Ask me on Monday.
Have a good weekend, genuinely
You too.
Where are we on the July 17th commitment? Board's asking.
On track for the model, not for the write-up. I'd rather ship it and document in the week after.
Fine by me. Tell me on the 15th if that changes.
Still on track. Write-up will land the 22nd.
Good. Thanks for the heads up.
Shipped. Numbers are in the channel, I'll do the write-up next week as agreed.
Nice work. Genuinely — that was a tight one.
Write-up's done and linked from the doc.
Thank you. I'll point the board at it and see if anyone bites.
Nobody will bite.
Did the queue backlog clear overnight?
Mostly. Still ~4k stuck on the retry topic, I'll drain it manually.
Want a hand?
Nah, twenty minutes.
Drained. The dead-letter handling needs rewriting at some point, it's held together with hope.
Put it on the list
The list is where things go to be at peace
Are you the owner of the events schema or is that a myth
Myth. I'm just the last person who touched it, which is different and worse.
That's ownership with extra steps
The recommender work that's landing — is that the one with the nightly refresh?
Yeah. Serving side is mine, the model side isn't. Should be straightforward if the feature store behaves.
Famous last words
It's always the feature store.
How was the review?
Fine. I raised a few things on the eval side that I didn't think held together. Better to say it in the room than after.
Did they land ok?
Hard to tell. Nobody argued, which usually means yes or means no.
Have you seen the new Denis Villeneuve?
Not yet. Is it long
Everything he makes is long. That's the point of him.
I'll go on a Saturday then
Correct approach. Cinema, not laptop.
I don't own a laptop I'd watch a film on
Second attempt: there's a 70mm screening on the 18th
Can't, away that weekend. Save me the recommendation.
Quick one — is the events API stable enough to build a dashboard on?
Stable, yes. Documented, no. Ask me before you build anything on it.
Story of my life
I'll write something up if you promise to read it
I promise to skim it with real intent
Watched it. You were right about the length. Also right about the rest.
Vindicated 🎬
Don't let it go to your head
Do you have a number for how long the recommender takes to serve at p95?
~40ms at current traffic. It'll go up when we turn on personalisation.
How far up?
Don't know yet. That's the work.
Can you give me a range I can put in front of people without it becoming a promise
40 to 90. Write "under 100" and we'll both be fine.
Under 100 it is
The dashboard review is going to turn up things you own, fair warning
Expected. Send them to me directly rather than in a doc, I'll actually read them.
Deal
Review went alright I thought
Yeah, decent. I pushed back on the eval numbers a bit, they didn't quite hang together for me.
Fair enough.
For what it's worth I'd have led with the question rather than the conclusion, but the point was right.
Noted.
Are we going to make the 26th for the serving migration?
Yes, assuming nothing else lands on me.
Nothing else will land on you. I'll make sure of it.
Migration's done, a day early.
Excellent. Noted and appreciated.
The rollback path is documented this time. In the runbook, not in my head.
That is the sentence I most wanted to read today.
No incidents overnight. Well done.
Did you ever get the backfill numbers you were waiting on?
Eventually. Nine days. For a query.
Nine *days*
Nine days.
Did you chase?
Twice. Politely. I've stopped being able to tell whether polite is working or whether polite is the problem.
Polite is not the problem.
Priya says you two did the recommender and the dashboard between you last sprint. That's a lot for something nobody asked for.
It was the good kind of extra. And there was no split to it — we sat on the same problems the whole fortnight, both of us in all of it.
So either of you could do either of them.
Genuinely one of the better fortnights I've had here.
Do you still have the cluster counts from the last segmentation refresh? I want to check the labels are stable.
Somewhere. I'll dig them out — fair warning, one of the clusters is just 'people who bookmark things and never return'.
That is the most useful cluster we have and you know it
Can I complain for a second
Always

Every time I need something from Marcus it sits for a week, and then it comes back with a little lecture about how I should have asked differently. Last time he rewrote my query "to help" and didn't tell me, and I presented the wrong number to Sven.
I've decided I'm not doing another piece of work with him. I mean it — I'd start looking elsewhere before I did that again. Please don't repeat that, it would go badly for me.
Not repeating it. That sounds genuinely awful and you're allowed to be done.
Did you ever tell him about the Sven thing?
No. What would I say that doesn't sound like I'm blaming him for my own number?
Anyway. Thanks. I feel better for saying it out loud.
Say it out loud any time.
saw the sprint list go up — you ok about the Marcus thing?
The in-product survey — do you want the free-text box before or after the rating?
After. Ask for words first and people write less of everything.
Beautiful. Shipping it.
Follow-up: what do we do when someone writes an entire novel in the box
We read it. Those are always the good ones.
Perfect software
Do you have a spare half hour this week? I want to sanity-check the survey wording with someone who hasn't been staring at it for a fortnight.
That's the nicest way anyone has ever called me ignorant. Thursday?
Thursday.
You seemed flat yesterday, are you ok?
Tired mostly. And I've been stewing about Marcus — the query thing, where I ended up giving Sven a wrong number because he'd changed something without telling me.
I've made my mind up that I'm not being put on anything with him again. Keep that between us though.
Sealed. And that would have made me furious, for what it's worth.
It did make me furious. I just did it quietly and at home.
Anyway — after the rating. Ship it.
Shipped an hour ago. Live your life.
Do you know who owns the events schema now?
Officially nobody. Practically Marcus, but ask in the channel first or you'll get told off.
Of course it's practically Marcus.
I'm not touching that one 😄
Wise
Is there a reason the audit events have two timestamp fields
One is when it happened and one is when we heard about it. Nobody labelled them.
Which is which
Nobody knows that either. Use the smaller one.
Did you get what you needed on the schema?
I worked it out from the raw payloads in the end. Faster.
Depressingly often the answer
Are the metrics definitions in the dashboard the same as the ones in the board deck?
No, and that's exactly why the review is happening.
I feel vindicated and also worried
Correct response.
How far back does the divergence go
I stopped looking at March for my own wellbeing.
If it helps, the definitions doc has an owner field and it says "TBD"
It has said TBD for two years. TBD is the owner.
If you need a second pair of eyes on the definitions I've got some time the week after next
Noted, thank you. Might take you up on it once we know who's on it.
Do you know who's on it?
Monday's problem.
Is there a reason the retention chart and the retention number disagree by 3 points?
Different definitions of "active". There are four of them.
Four.
Four.
Right. That's going in the review.
Do you want the list or will it upset you
Send the list. I'll be upset productively.
List sent. Number five appeared while I was writing it.
Of course it did
Did the definitions survive contact with management?
They did not. There are now six.
Six!
Two of them are the same definition with different names, which I'm told doesn't count.
It counts
Omar — the staging environment audit you promised for the infra review, is Thursday still realistic?
Thursday yes, but it'll be a doc, not a deck. You said that was fine last time.
A doc is fine. A doc that exists beats a deck that doesn't.
Audit doc's in the infra folder. Flagged two cost items for you, nothing urgent.
Seen it, thanks. I'll bring the cost items to the review myself.
Ines — analytics-platform kickoff is Monday 11:00. Can you make sure the metrics backlog is groomed before then?
Already on it. I'll have it down to a page by Friday.
Backlog's groomed and linked from the sprint doc. Warning: it was three pages, it is now one, people will complain.
They always complain at one page and never read three. See you Monday.
Haruki — before you disappear into on-call: anything from the checkout follow-up that needs to land on someone else's desk?
No, it's contained. Two config changes left, both mine. I'll keep the incident doc current.
Morning — quiet weekend, no pages. Doing the first config change today.
Good start to the week then. I'm in calls most of the morning, doc me anything that changes.
Helena — planning offsite moved to Sep 3. Does your team summary slide survive the move or do you want a new deadline?
It survives. It's two bullets and a graph, it can be any date you like.
The graph is the part I worry about.
The graph goes up and to the right, Sven. Sep 3 is fine.
Zofia — can you take the portfolio screen for the frontend candidate on Wednesday? 45 min, rubric's in the hiring doc.
Can do. Same rubric as June?
Same rubric, one new question about design systems. It's marked.
On it. Calendar invite me.
